custody.ingress: Opaque binding ID; optional exact SDK signature compares trusted pointer identities before dereference
custody.attempts: One attempted installation per binding; reserve before side effects; no reset/retry/unpatch/destroy
custody.typed_owner: Copied validated Community identity or typed Core; ambient string is never admission

decisions.locking: Community cm -> common writer -> azmod protection; Core writer -> protection; no reverse writer -> cm; phase transition under same writer; actual protection stage added only in future successor
decisions.reservation: Reserve binding, target16, immutable metadata and resource-journal capacity first; returned mappings are retained immediately; derive actual ncopy/out and validate storage conflicts before island writes and final target unlock

journal.bound_premise: Serial private uncorrupted four-pool allocator; first empty pool either exhausts hints and returns or supplies a fresh slot
journal.candidate_cleanup: Every successful out-of-reach mapping gets a cleanup receipt; failed cleanup retains uncertain custody
journal.pool: 64KiB mapping/page ownership distinct from 16-byte consumed slot; do not release a shared pool because one attempt fails

layout.trampoline_mapping: 4096 bytes in exact source, separately checked against actual platform constraints
layout.relocation_authority: Actual installer out and ncopy; out = ncopy + 3*expanded_ADRP_count as consistency check

receipts.syscalls: attempted, underlying_called, injected, raw result, errno_valid only on failure, immediate errno, address/length/protection, custody outcome
receipts.query: Open/read/parse/close categories distinct; parser refusal has no invented syscall errno
receipts.protection: Separate initialized island and target tokens; token_valid only on actual successful unlock; retain saved bits, rounded extent and relock separately
receipts.cleanup: Successful munmap releases only that mapping; failure/unknown result retains uncertain custody
receipts.cache: Record request and observed normal return only; builtin supplies no success status

decisions.rounding_guard: Inside the future copied helper, bind its one actual page-size value: require positive representable power-of-two size, checked addr+len and +pg-1, and nonempty rounded span before mapping operations. Value-only malformed tests precede native dereference; a separate unbound preflight sysconf is insufficient.

decisions.diagnostics: Optional saturated diagnostic table must not determine transaction success or cleanup eligibility
decisions.source_transformation: Separately named copied-source successor with exact reviewed diff; retained original installer/reference bodies remain frozen. Cannot claim byte-identical unchanged installer after adding internal receipt/publication seam.
decisions.first_runtime_scope: Late-island only for both Core and Community; real allocator/protection/cache on isolated authored targets, no firmware or live observer. Unsupported no-island path remains refused; fallback deferred.
decisions.record_visibility: Prefill immutable owner/instruction/target/storage metadata, then release-commit once; subsequent mutable stage/warning journal is separate and is never read by immutable lookup.

evidence_limits: This plan and its byte packet execute no installer, compiler, make, firmware or test matrix.
Source anchor hashes establish byte identity, not semantic correctness or runtime coverage.
Future injected refusals are authored path evidence, not real kernel failures.
Ownership is not fault causation; quarantine and all live gates remain closed.
